name: Hiroko Takahashi
about:
Hiroko Takahashi is the representative of C.I.N.N. (Contact Improvisation Nippon Network), a non-profit group of Kanto-area dancers that promotes contact improvisation. She has led the group since it was founded as SPIRAL in 2003 and handles the planning, production and running of its activities.

C.I.N.N. organises the Tokyo Contact Improvisation Festival. The 2026 edition ran 2-5 May 2026 at the Nippon Budokan Training Center in Katsuura, Chiba. Its website also lists one-off CI workshops, jams and roundtables in Tokyo.

For a visiting artist, she is the main contact for Tokyo's contact improvisation community and its yearly festival, which invites teachers from abroad.
notes: Romanised name appears on the staff page. Her role line dates from the group's founding in 2003; the 2026 activity is confirmed by the 2026 festival on the homepage (https://www.contactimprov-nn.com/). The festival is called 'Tokyo' but the 2026 edition was held in Katsuura, Chiba. Not confirmed as the organiser of the Nishiogikubo jam (tyo-nishiogi-ci), so not linked to it. Same page: Maaya Fukumoto (福本まあや, overseas teacher liaison, organised CI Roundtable #1 in April 2025) is a possible second row if the team wants one.

name: Kota Yamazaki
about:
Kota Yamazaki is the director of Body Arts Laboratory (BAL), an artist-run organisation for dance and performance founded in Tokyo in 2008. Through BAL he runs the Whenever Wherever Festival (WWFes), an experimental dance and performance festival programmed by a collective of dancers and choreographers.

WWFes has run regularly since 2009, with editions in 2025 and 2026. According to Arts Council Tokyo, the 12th festival took place in February 2026 at public, community and municipal spaces in Minato Ward. BAL's site also lists a team of five curators, including Aokid.

For a visiting artist, WWFes is one of Tokyo's few artist-run festivals of experimental dance, set in non-theatre spaces.
notes: WEAK ON ROMANISATION: the BAL about page I opened names 山崎広太 as ディレクター in Japanese only. The romanisation 'Kota Yamazaki' (as 'Director: Kota Yamazaki' of BAL) appears in Arts Council Tokyo grant records (https://www.artscouncil-tokyo.jp/en/what-we-do/support/program/71622), but I saw it only in a search snippet because WebFetch returned 404. The 2026 edition is confirmed by the ACT grant page I opened (https://www.artscouncil-tokyo.jp/en/grants/program/27829/), which does not name a director. He is also an active choreographer (Sumida Art Festival, Sep 2026). The BAL curators (Aokid, 岩中可南子, 五月めい, 西村未奈, 福留麻里) are leads, but only Aokid's name is romanised on that page.
